Replace your entire software stack

Service businesses juggle a CRM, a scheduler, a quoting tool, an invoicing app, and a pile of spreadsheets — none of which talk to each other. CoreSight is the single system that does all of it, so your team manages leads, jobs, and customers in one connected place. Let your team focus on growing and building, not trying to fix bottlenecks.

Core Call · Smart Lead Intake

Never miss a call. Never miss a lead.Never miss a detail.

Core Call captures every inbound call as a lead — whether it goes to voicemail or a team member answers live. From there, the platform transcribes and summarizes the conversation and automatically updates the customer and job records, so the details capture themselves and nothing slips through.

01 · AI Intake
Core Call pulls every important detail from an incoming call — voicemail or answered live.
02 · Lead Created
A lead is created automatically, with the customer's information already filled in.
03 · Summarized
Every conversation is summarized with the relevant details captured.
04 · One Page
Whoever talks to the customer, the whole team stays on the same page — no missing details, no lost context.

Who It's For

Built for businesses that run on service

CoreSight is built for service and trade businesses — the teams whose success depends on how fast a lead becomes a scheduled, completed, and paid job. You should be focused on growing your business, not fighting bottlenecks created by messy, disconnected software.

If you provide a service, CoreSight is your engine.
How It Works

Our business model

CoreSight Systems LLC is a B2B software company. We license our platform to service and trade businesses under a Master Service Agreement — it's a subscription service for companies, not a consumer product.

A business subscribes

A service or trade company licenses the CoreSight platform under a written service agreement.

We provision their workspace

Each client gets their own configured, branded environment with the modules their business needs enabled — and we migrate their existing data in.

They run their operation

The client's staff manage leads, schedules, quotes, jobs, and invoices for their own customers inside the platform.

Everyone stays aligned

The whole team works from one live view of every lead, job, and customer, and customers are kept informed as their job moves forward.

Grow

Efficiently grow your business with smarter tools. You don't need more office staff — you need a better system.

Privacy Policy

Last updated June 2026

CoreSight Systems LLC ("CoreSight," "we," "us") provides software services to business clients. This policy describes how we handle information collected through our platform and this website.

Information We Collect

We collect business contact information provided voluntarily through our services, including name, email address, phone number, and business address. We also collect usage data to operate and improve our platform.

How We Use Information

Information is used solely to deliver our services, communicate about your account, and fulfill our contractual obligations. We do not sell or share personal information with third parties except as required to deliver the service or to comply with law. We do not sell or share mobile phone numbers or SMS consent information with any third parties or affiliates for marketing purposes.

SMS and Communications

CoreSight Systems, and the businesses using the CoreSight platform, may send SMS text messages related to service operations, including appointment confirmations and reminders, quote and proposal notifications, job and service status updates, and account-related communications.

Customers and staff provide consent to receive these messages through their relationship with the CoreSight client business — for example, when requesting service, scheduling an appointment, or providing a phone number to the business. CoreSight clients are responsible for obtaining appropriate consent from their own customers before messaging them through the platform.

Message frequency varies based on service activity. Message and data rates may apply. You can opt out at any time by replying STOP, after which you will receive no further messages except a confirmation of opt-out. For help, reply HELP or contact us at coresight.systems@gmail.com. We do not sell or share mobile phone numbers or SMS consent information with third parties.

Data Retention

We retain client data for the duration of the service agreement plus 12 months, unless otherwise specified in writing.

Contact

Questions about this policy can be sent to coresight.systems@gmail.com.
